name: Switch
summary: Turns one optional thing on or off, such as an optional permission on the Connect page.

when: For an optional setting that takes effect as a whole, such as letting an app see your email address.

whenNot.text: For agreeing to terms: use a checkbox.

props.name: label
props.description: What it turns on. Pass a catalogue string.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the form submits the value under.

props.name: value
props.description: What the form submits when it's on.

states.name: On
states.description: The thumb at the end, in the selected colours.

accessibility.name: Its label; its description is tied to it.
screenReader: Announced as a switch with its label, and “on” or “off”.
notes: The whole row is the target, at least 44px high.
On and off differ by position as well as colour.

related.relationship: The Connect page's permissions, which use it for optional ones.

guidelines: The label says what it turns on, not “Enable”.
Changes take effect when the form is submitted, not instantly, unless the page says otherwise.

dosAndDonts.do: Use it for one optional setting.
dosAndDonts.dont: Use it for a required choice.
